entities.name: Query protein 425 aa
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt P24326, a reviewed Haemophilus influenzae inner-membrane multipass protein.
Sequence length 425 aa; calculated molecular mass 47.35 kDa; predicted pI 8.74; GRAVY 0.751.
Pfam MFS_1 domain spans residues 18–373; Acatn domain spans residues 25–147.

entities.name: AmpG
observations: Reviewed Escherichia coli anhydromuropeptide permease transports GlcNAc-anhMurNAc and GlcNAc-anhMurNAc-peptides from periplasm to cytoplasm.
Transport depends on the proton motive force.
AmpG participates in peptidoglycan recycling and can contribute to beta-lactamase induction in E. coli.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan recycling
observations: AmpG-mediated import of anhydromuropeptides supplies cytoplasmic products of cell-wall turnover for recycling.
The exact downstream pathway and beta-lactamase regulatory role are species-dependent and should not be assumed solely from sequence homology.

entities.name: Bacterial inner membrane
observations: The query protein is annotated as a multipass inner-membrane protein; in Gram-negative bacteria this corresponds to the cytoplasmic membrane.
